note_to_reader: These notes have been through an editing pass. The other notes in each family are printed with them so a claim about a word's position on its family's spectrum can be checked against the words it is being compared with.

senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Informal, and the only one of these that shows the wrong from the sufferer's side - the person is imposed on and visibly feels it, where *ill-used* and *exploited* merely report what was done to them.
senses.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: used incorrectly or carelessly or for an improper purpose
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flattest of these - it faults the handling, whether careless or deliberate, without yet accusing anyone of cruelty.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: used improperly or excessively especially drugs
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Harder than *misused* because excess joins impropriety - the fault lies in how much as well as how, drugs squarely included.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Cold and calculating beside *ill-used* - it implies someone drew profit from the person, and names the gain rather than the hurt.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Formal and plain-spoken - a verdict that a wrong was done, without *exploited*'s implication that anyone gained by it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Bare and cutting - the unmodified participle reduces the person to an instrument, saying far less than *exploited* and landing colder for it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The strongest of the set - it does not merely report the wrong but makes the person's whole standing consist in having suffered it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: British spelling of *victimized*, and it carries the same total verdict - the person defined by the wrong rather than merely subjected to it.

senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Mockery that goes past unseriousness to vacancy - it does not merely find the person frivolous but alleges there is nothing inside to be serious with, where *dizzy* only sets the head spinning.
senses.axis: harmless lightness → unseriousness mocked as a defect of mind

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not serious in content or attitude or behavior
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The family's plain term and its widest, attaching to content, attitude or behaviour alike without the picture of a hollow head that the compounds beside it supply.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Blunt mockery that explains the unseriousness by putting air where the thinking should be, where *frivolous* just reports the lack.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Whirl rather than vacancy, the lightest hit in the group and closer to teasing than to the contempt in *empty-headed*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Mockery by weighing the brain, making the frivolity ridiculous rather than merely noting it as *silly* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Lightness with a lift to it, the unseriousness felt as high spirits, so it stings far less than *empty-headed*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The same charge as *giddy* stated as a property of the head rather than a mood, and a light head is still not the vacant one *empty-headed* alleges.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The unhyphenated twin of *light-headed*, identical in force: a light head, not an empty one.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking seriousness; given to frivolity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plainest and most forgiving word for the fault, naming the frivolity without a metaphor for the head and leaving room for fondness that *airheaded* forecloses.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: guided by whim and fancy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Whim read as unreliability, so it warns about conduct where *head-in-the-clouds* only pictures a drift.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: guided by whim and fancy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The lightest reading of a life run by whim and fancy: loose and ungoverned rather than a fault to be answered for.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: guided by whim and fancy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Indulgent almost to fondness, the whim and fancy carrying the person off rather than damning them, unlike *scatterbrained*'s charge of disorder.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: guided by whim and fancy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Whim as scatter: the fault is that attention will not hold together, which *flighty* leaves as mere changeability.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: showing inappropriate levity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The verdict is built in, the levity being out of place, so the word rebukes a manner rather than diagnosing a mind as *empty-headed* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: showing inappropriate levity
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The measured version of *flippant*'s fault, locating the misplaced levity in a cast of mind instead of throwing it back at the offender.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: silly or trivial
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: It runs to two things at once, the silly and the trivial, so the dismissal is as much about weightlessness as about foolishness.

senses.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Names the loss of order as a state the thing has been put into and leaves it there, without the damage *broken* implies or the fresh upheaval *upset* pictures.
senses.axis: merely unmethodical → snarled into total wreckage

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The family's plain statement of the fault - order, methodical arrangement and working function all simply absent, with none of the wreckage *chaotic* pictures.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking order or methodical arrangement or function
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Carries exactly the force of *disorganized*; the spelling is the whole of the difference.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Of a thing thrown into disarray rather than snapped in two - the confusion reads as damage done to it, not merely order gone missing.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Puts the muddle in the thing itself rather than in anyone's head - it is the arrangement that is tangled, not a mind.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Pictures the disarray as a tipping-over: the arrangement knocked out of place rather than destroyed, and the upheaval still fresh.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking a visible order or organization
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Sharpens the charge into a spectacle - not a trace of order or organization to be seen, where *disorganized* merely notes the lack.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: lacking a visible order or organization
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Its jingling shape makes the same invisible order sound hectic and headlong, far lighter in judgement than *chaotic*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Coarse and total - a snarl or dead stop treated as a botch someone is answerable for, the harshest word in the family.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Names the same total snarl-up or standstill with a clipped, almost breezy label - rueful where *fucked-up* is furious.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown together in a disorderly fashion
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Faults the making rather than the thing: pieces flung together in haste, so the disorder sits in how it was put together.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not efficient or methodical
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The coolest reproach here - it faults the missing method and the inefficiency that comes with it, and pictures no wreckage at all.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Pictures the collapse as a coming-apart - what was holding gives way, and the disorganization or incoherence follows from that.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Sounds the same collapse as an unmaking, graver and more final than *unstuck* - the thing not merely loosened but ruined.

senses.definition: so unreasonable as to invite derision
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Puts the derision in the response rather than in the thing - what is named is the laugh it draws, so it dismisses by amusement where *preposterous* repudiates out loud.
senses.axis: absurdity that draws open contempt → light, laughable foolishness

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: devoid of good sense or judgment
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plain, unadorned charge that good sense or judgement is simply absent, with none of the mockery *ridiculous* invites.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Puts the unreasonableness first and lets the derision follow as a verdict, where *laughable* starts from the laugh.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Informal and offhand, treating the thing as skewed out of true and waving it away rather than arguing with it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Carries the scorn in its own body: the thing is not merely open to derision but fit for nothing else.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Hits hardest of these, aiming the derision squarely at whoever produced the thing rather than at the thing itself.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Theatrical, full-blown absurdity, grander than *laughable* and past the point where argument is possible.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Locates the failure in the sense itself, so nothing coherent is left to answer, where *absurd* still concedes a shape to reject.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Formal and indignant, repudiating the absurdity out loud rather than merely laughing at it as *laughable* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: so unreasonable as to invite derision
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Blunt and immediate, the derision arriving without the argument *absurd* implies.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: devoid of intelligence or thought
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Nothing at all stands behind it, neither intelligence nor thought, a flatter and heavier charge than *foolish*'s bad judgement.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: devoid of intelligence or thought
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Formal and colder than *mindless*, treating the absence of intelligence or thought as a settled quality of the thing.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: devoid of intelligence or thought
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Names the emptiness as blankness rather than stupidity, the intelligence and thought simply not in evidence.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: ludicrous, foolish
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Almost fond, taking the foolishness as entertainment rather than a fault, a long way from *idiotic*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: ludicrous, foolish
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The gentlest word here, foolish and ludicrous at a scale too small to be worth condemning.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: ludicrous, foolish
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Foolishness with energy behind it, off-kilter and lively where *silly* is merely slight.

senses.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: The wear is conceded and then not held against the thing - overuse has smoothed it rather than used it up, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same wearing.
senses.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flat statement of the fault - nothing fresh in the thing and nothing fresh coming out of it - delivered without the scorn *trite* carries.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Dismissal rather than description: the repetition has emptied the thing out, where *commonplace* only notes that it has been met before.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Puts the fault in ordinariness rather than in damage - the thing is met everywhere rather than worn thin, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same overuse.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: A formal-sounding verdict that the thing has been run into the ground, heavier and more deliberate than *tired*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Informal and offhand: it shrugs at how familiar the thing has become instead of condemning it the way *banal* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The overuse leaves a mark, as though the thing had been handled until the shine came off it - grubbier than *well-worn*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flattest word here - it files the endless repetition almost as a category rather than a fault, with none of the disgust in *trite*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The wear has gone all the way through: the thing still holds its shape but has nothing left in it, harsher than *well-worn*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Lays the wearing at time's door rather than at any user's: the overuse registers as accumulated age, not as the running-into-the-ground that *hackneyed* convicts someone of.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Blunt and plain: the thing has simply gone slack from repetition, a flatter judgement than the arch *bromidic*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The hardest word in the family - it does not merely note the overuse, it writes the thing off as worthless for it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Keeps a straight face while it convicts - dull, wearying and puffed up with significance, all named at once, where *corny* simply laughs.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Informal and mocking: both the dullness and the airs come off as laughable, lighter on its feet than *platitudinous*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The drier of the pair - it names the tiresome self-importance almost clinically, without the heavy roll of *platitudinous*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: A weightier, more sonorous word than *platitudinal*, and its own bulk is part of the mockery: dullness dressed up and then shown up.

senses.definition: causing distress or worry or anxiety
senses.label: negative
senses.tone: The formal member of the group, registering the trouble as a mind put out of its settled state, where *disturbing* unseats it and *distressing* names outright hurt.
senses.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: marked by great psychological weight; weighted down especially with sadness or troubles or
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plainest name for the condition itself, sadness or trouble felt as weight from inside, where *burdensome* describes the load from outside.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Puts the difficulty in the thing rather than the bearer: a load fixed on you that has to be carried, not merely a strain that tires.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The formal member, and the heaviest-sounding of the three, where *taxing* keeps the same complaint everyday.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: not easily borne; wearing
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Leans on the wearing half of the sense, draining strength steadily rather than crushing, the lightest of the three.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plain, full-strength member of the group, naming real hurt and not merely unease.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*, with the same weight of hurt behind it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Aimed at composure rather than comfort, it unsettles and goes on unsettling, where *distressing* simply hurts.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Quiet and persistent, a worry that nags at you instead of striking, understated beside *distressing*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Treats the power to cause anxiety as a standing property of the thing, where *worrying* reports what it is doing now.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing distress or worry or anxiety
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The most physical word in the family, heaviness and weariness fused into dead metal, dull and unliftable.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: made heavy or weighted down with weariness
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flattest member, recording that the weight has been put on without making the weariness of it felt as *leaden* does.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: weighing heavily on the senses or spirit
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The strongest weight here, pressing on the senses as much as on the spirit and leaving no room to breathe.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: weighing heavily on the spirit; causing anxiety or worry
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Grave rather than smothering, the weight registering as anxiety carried, where *oppressive* closes in.

senses.label: negative
senses.tone: Informal, and it tints the mood rather than convicting the thing - dejection carried as a colour, where *dark* throws a shadow over what it names and *dismal* passes sentence on it.
senses.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Blunt and unhedged, it names the effect on the person outright, reaching self-regard as well as mood where *cheerless* only reports what is missing.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Works by absence — nothing here to lift anyone — so it sinks the spirits without ever accusing the thing of anything.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The flattest of these, a bare negation registering the missing cheer without the settled bleakness *cheerless* carries.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The dejection is cast over a thing rather than sitting inside it — a shadow, where *dreary* is a long dull stretch.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Dispirits in a small, unfreshened way, too minor for the sweep of *dismal* but enough to flatten a mood.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: It marks a thing as past consoling, so the dejection comes with no way out of it, heavier in that than *gloomy*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: A flat, sweeping verdict of bleakness that sinks the spirits harder than *gloomy* and leaves nothing to salvage.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The plain middle of the family, naming the dejection without heightening it, where *dismal* passes judgement on it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The hardest here, the gloom it causes carrying an edge of harshness, where *dreary* only wears you down.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Dejection mixed with contempt: what it names is not merely dispiriting but pitiable, which *gloomy* never implies.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Dejection by monotony — it flattens rather than darkens, dispiriting without the menace of *grim*.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Barer and more literary than *dreary*, the same gloom in a word with nothing spare left in it.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: causing dejection
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Gloom that goes on and wearies, so where *dismal* can be a single verdict this one drags.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: grave or even gloomy in character
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: Gravity first and gloom only at its far end, which lets it carry dignity in a way *dismal* cannot.

other_notes_in_this_family.gloss: grave or even gloomy in character
other_notes_in_this_family.tone: The British spelling and the same word entirely: grave in weight, gloomy only when pushed to its limit.
